# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.54

Changes since version [0.0.53](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.53).

## Improved

- The file manager button appears on the left side of the VS Code Status Bar.

## Fixed

- Deleting a file while its folder is still loading keeps the remaining files visible. No manual refresh is needed.

## Updating

Update Bitfroest.fs through the VS Code Extensions view on the pre-release channel. Packages are built for Windows x64 and Linux x64. The Apple Silicon package remains experimental.
